name: Iwashimizu Maiko
source:
She is a third-year student who is the student body president and vice-chairman of the committee.
 
She is very popular among some boys because of her small body size. She is always serious, but is often pushed around by the committee members.

[From [url=http://pacopacosoft.jp/dl/pk004/]official site[/url]]
